body: Chief on the AlignWire candidate 3c1777e: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS — independent run align 117/117 JVM+JS, laws 76/76, fixtures 96/96, interview 30/30, compileAll; fresh-context review from the laws package confirmed every item (nomination rejections; derivation over exactly the nominated set — un-nominated faithful mass rejected; echo compare-only → GateDrift; order-invariant fingerprints that flip on text/grounding; factory rejections incl. scalar ≠ reducer and coverage mismatch; all four record/key forgeries generated 30/30; tag tokens first; ADR D5.1 matches; infer nominates exactly set(u).ranked). REQUIRED before landing: (1) MEDIUM — infer now FAILS whenever a candidate ref is absent from the view: run emits Source(ref) → CostBreakdown.unreachable (hsmm.scala:530-533) and infer nominates it (:474), so validated rejects with 'nominated anchor absent from the source view' and Exclusion.Unreachable is dead (probe: one alien candidate → Left). Fix: drop view-absent refs from both the nominated map and the cost keys in infer, with a test that an alien candidate yields a valid result and an Unreachable-free/recorded outcome as you decide — do not let validated accept absent anchors; (2) hsmm.scala:332 view.node(ref).get in main — derive with flatMap even though the nomination pass guards it. Document (in the same candidate): AlignWire.costBreakdown cannot verify total against terms (weights are not on the record) — say 'total is a cached value, not verified on the wire' or carry the weights; AdmissibilityEcho.of is count-prefixed fixed-arity, not tagged — align the ADR sentence or the code; retitle the foil-based forgery law (it never yields the un-nominated class; the Case-based law covers it). Repost the SHA + align/laws 3-platform evidence; I re-run and land; codec + gemini then build on the landed SHA.
